title: Reproducible Cytokine Drift Detection in Shared Lab Notebooks
abstract: We combine notebook-derived feature checks with versioned cytokine observations to reduce irreproducible conclusions [@ortiz2025; @park2024].

sections.heading: Methods
sections.body: The editor keeps Markdown, inline LaTeX $y = mx + b$, and code snippets in one manuscript. The data preparation cell cites the dataset [@dataset-immune-7] and runtime \cite{scibase2026}. See {{fig:pipeline}} and {{eq:drift-score}} for the pipeline contract.

sections.heading: Results
sections.body: The reference manager resolves duplicate inline citations without renumbering later sections [@ortiz2025]. The tabular output is summarized in {{tbl:quality-gates}}.
